editorial.blurb: 14 Parish brings Caribbean island vibes and bold, well-seasoned cooking to a cozy neighborhood spot, with stellar cocktails and attentive bartenders keeping the energy high.
editorial.insiderTip: Make a reservation—the space is small and fills up fast. Sit at the bar if you can to watch the bartender work and enjoy live service energy, and don't sleep on the jerk sauce; ask for it on the side to elevate any dish.
